transcript: Took Biscuit to Dolores Park this morning. He found a tennis ball and refused to give it back. Sat on the hill with my sister, we split a burrito and watched people play frisbee. Later it got super windy so we went home and napped. Pretty perfect lazy Sunday honestly.

spec.moment: Sitting on the park hill splitting a burrito while the dog refuses to drop his tennis ball.

spec.scene: A bright green grassy slope tilts gently from back to front, bathed in warm morning light. In the center, two figures sit side by side on a small picnic blanket: one in a denim jacket and one in a soft lilac sweater, sharing halves of a silver foil burrito. Right beside them, a scruffy tan dog proudly clamps a slightly oversized bright lime tennis ball in his jaws. Along the back edge, two tiny figures toss a red disc beneath the slender trunk of a single palm tree.
spec.title: Lazy Sunday with Biscuit
spec.caption: Split a burrito on the hill while Biscuit hoarded his new tennis ball.
